## Purpose
Run-time industry knowledge. It does lexical retrieval over reference items filed on the catalog domain tree, expanded both up and down the hierarchy, and wraps the results in an attribution contract so agents mark unsourced figures. It also keeps the legacy CRUD interface the routes use.

## Responsibilities
- `KINDS`: definition, regulation, process, metric, risk, best_practice and glossary.
- `_tokens` uses `catalog.match.tokens` with `QUESTION_STOPWORDS`.
- **`_to_dict(item)`** returns the legacy shape `{id, concept_id, kind (= the category), title, body, tags, as_of, source (= the origin)}`.
- `ensure_schema()` delegates to `store.ensure_schema`.
- **CRUD:**
  - `list_entries(concept_id, kind, limit)` returns active items whose audience is runtime or both;
  - **`upsert_entry(concept_id, title, body, kind, tags, source, as_of)`:**
    - needs all three of concept, title and body, and an existing concept;
    - `best_practice` becomes guidance with audience both;
    - it is keyed on `(concept_id, title)`;
  - `delete_entry` and `counts()`.
- **`_scope_concepts(domains)`** returns the descendants and ancestors of each domain.
- **`search(query, domains, kind, limit=5)`:**
  - **scoring:** title hits ×3, tag hits ×2 and body hits ×1. Without a query every entry scores 0.5; with a query, a zero score is dropped;
  - **boosts:** +4 for the exact requested concept, and +0.75 × the concept's level;
  - **order:** by score descending, then title;
  - results include `score`.
- **`has_coverage(domains)`, `agent_has_coverage(agent_id)` and `domains_for_agent(agent_id)`.** `domains_for_agent` reads the `SERVES_DOMAIN` annotations, without `domain.system`. An agent with no domain has no coverage.
- **`_ATTRIBUTION_CONTRACT`** is a four-rule header, copied verbatim. Its rules are: prefer the sourced material; write "(unverified)" after any unsourced figure; cite "As of" dates; say so when nothing answers the question.
- **`render_for_prompt(entries)`:**
  - each entry becomes "### title / - Domain: label (id) / - Type / - As of" plus the body, under the contract;
  - with no entries it returns "No industry knowledge matched that query." with the instruction to mark unsourced specifics "(unverified)".

## Key elements
`search`, `render_for_prompt`, `agent_has_coverage`, `domains_for_agent`, `upsert_entry`.

## Control flow
Pure reads over the store.

## Data, state and side effects
Reads `knowledge_items` and the catalog.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Used by:** `rag/domain_search.py` (the `search_domain_knowledge` tool), `routes/knowledge.py` and the catalog seeding.
- **`SessionLocal` is imported** only so tests can patch it.

## Error handling and edge cases
- Annotation read failures give no domains.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **The attribution contract exists because of an observed failure.** An agent combined a sourced "+1-3% above pay rate" with an invented "BoE base rate is 5.25%" in one seamless paragraph.
- **A short, literal token works where a long explanation was skimmed.**
- **`domain.system` holds no knowledge.** Returning it would make guardrail agents look covered.
- **Retrieval is lexical on purpose.** A model call on the tool path would double the latency of every agent turn that uses it.

## How to rebuild this file
As described, copying the contract verbatim.

## Tests
`backend/tests/test_knowledge_context.py` and `test_catalog_simplification.py`.
